item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 01/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, it will be very hot over southern China tomorrow. An easterly airstream is expected to bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong early next week. A broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Mawar now over the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands will move towards the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days, and become an extratropical cyclone gradually.
